doc: `(G × H) / (A × B)` is in bijection with `G / A × H / B`.
statement:

  (q : (G × H) ⧸ A.prod B),

    Quotient.liftOn' q
      (fun x =>
        match x with

      ⋯

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] {H : Type v} [inst_1 : Group H] (φ : G →* H) (ψ : H → G)

doc:

statement:

  [inst : Group G] →
    {A' A B' B : Subgroup G} →
      [_hAN : (A'.subgroupOf A).Normal] →
        [_hBN : (B'.subgroupOf B).Normal] → A' ≤ B' → A ≤ B → ↥A ⧸ A'.subgroupOf A →* ↥B ⧸ B'.subgroupOf B

doc:
Let `A', A, B', B` be subgroups of `G`. If `A' ≤ B'` and `A ≤ B`, then there is a
map `A / (A' ⊓ A) →+ B / (B' ⊓ B)` induced by the inclusions.
statement:
{G : Type u} →
  [inst : AddGroup G] →
    {A' A B' B : AddSubgroup G} →
      [_hAN : (A'.addSubgroupOf A).Normal] →
        [_hBN : (B'.addSubgroupOf B).Normal] → A' ≤ B' → A ≤ B → ↥A ⧸ A'.addSubgroupOf A →+ ↥B ⧸ B'.addSubgroupOf B

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] {A' A B' B : Subgroup G} [_hAN : (A'.subgroupOf A).Normal]
  [_hBN : (B'.subgroupOf B).Normal] (h' : A' ≤ B') (h : A ≤ B) (x : ↥A),
  (QuotientGroup.quotientMapSubgroupOfOfLe h' h) ↑x = ↑((Subgroup.inclusion h) x)

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] {A' A B' B : AddSubgroup G} [_hAN : (A'.addSubgroupOf A).Normal]
  [_hBN : (B'.addSubgroupOf B).Normal] (h' : A' ≤ B') (h : A ≤ B) (x : ↥A),
  (QuotientAddGroup.quotientMapAddSubgroupOfOfLe h' h) ↑x = ↑((AddSubgroup.inclusion h) x)

doc:
Let `A', A, B', B` be subgroups of `G`.
If `A' = B'` and `A = B`, then the quotients `A / (A' ⊓ A)` and `B / (B' ⊓ B)` are isomorphic.

Applying this equiv is nicer than rewriting along the equalities, since the type of
`(A'.subgroupOf A : Subgroup A)` depends on `A`.
statement:
{G : Type u} →
  [inst : Group G] →
    {A' A B' B : Subgroup G} →
      [hAN : (A'.subgroupOf A).Normal] →
        [hBN : (B'.subgroupOf B).Normal] → A' = B' → A = B → ↥A ⧸ A'.subgroupOf A ≃* ↥B ⧸ B'.subgroupOf B

doc:
Let `A', A, B', B` be subgroups of `G`. If `A' = B'` and `A = B`, then the
quotients `A / (A' ⊓ A)` and `B / (B' ⊓ B)` are isomorphic. Applying this equiv is nicer than
rewriting along the equalities, since the type of `(A'.addSubgroupOf A : AddSubgroup A)` depends on
`A`.
statement:
{G : Type u} →
  [inst : AddGroup G] →
    {A' A B' B : AddSubgroup G} →
      [hAN : (A'.addSubgroupOf A).Normal] →
        [hBN : (B'.addSubgroupOf B).Normal] → A' = B' → A = B → ↥A ⧸ A'.addSubgroupOf A ≃+ ↥B ⧸ B'.addSubgroupOf B

doc:
The map of quotients by multiples of an integer induced by an additive group
homomorphism.
statement:
{A B : Type u} →
  [inst : AddCommGroup A] →
    [inst_1 : AddCommGroup B] → (A →+ B) → (n : ℤ) → A ⧸ (zsmulAddGroupHom n).range →+ B ⧸ (zsmulAddGroupHom n).range

∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] (n : ℤ),
  QuotientAddGroup.homQuotientZSMulOfHom (AddMonoidHom.id A) n = AddMonoidHom.id (A ⧸ (zsmulAddGroupHom n).range)

∀ {A : Type u} [inst : CommGroup A] (n : ℤ),
  QuotientGroup.homQuotientZPowOfHom (MonoidHom.id A) n = MonoidHom.id (A ⧸ (zpowGroupHom n).range)

∀ {A B : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup B] (f : A →+ B) (g : B →+ A) (n : ℤ),
  QuotientAddGroup.homQuotientZSMulOfHom (f.comp g) n =
    (QuotientAddGroup.homQuotientZSMulOfHom f n).comp (QuotientAddGroup.homQuotientZSMulOfHom g n)

∀ {A B : Type u} [inst : CommGroup A] [inst_1 : CommGroup B] (f : A →* B) (g : B →* A) (n : ℤ),
  QuotientGroup.homQuotientZPowOfHom (f.comp g) n =
    (QuotientGroup.homQuotientZPowOfHom f n).comp (QuotientGroup.homQuotientZPowOfHom g n)

∀ {A B : Type u} [inst : CommGroup A] [inst_1 : CommGroup B] (f : A →* B) (g : B →* A) (n : ℤ),
  Function.RightInverse ⇑g ⇑f →
    (QuotientGroup.homQuotientZPowOfHom f n).comp (QuotientGroup.homQuotientZPowOfHom g n) =
      MonoidHom.id (B ⧸ (zpowGroupHom n).range)

∀ {A B : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup B] (f : A →+ B) (g : B →+ A) (n : ℤ),
  Function.RightInverse ⇑g ⇑f →
    (QuotientAddGroup.homQuotientZSMulOfHom f n).comp (QuotientAddGroup.homQuotientZSMulOfHom g n) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (B ⧸ (zsmulAddGroupHom n).range)

The equivalence of quotients by multiples of an integer induced by an additive
group isomorphism.
statement:
{A B : Type u} →

    [inst_1 : AddCommGroup B] → A ≃+ B → (n : ℤ) → A ⧸ (zsmulAddGroupHom n).range ≃+ B ⧸ (zsmulAddGroupHom n).range

∀ {A : Type u} [inst : CommGroup A] (n : ℤ),
  MulEquiv.refl (A ⧸ (zpowGroupHom n).range) = QuotientGroup.equivQuotientZPowOfEquiv (MulEquiv.refl A) n

∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] (n : ℤ),

∀ {A B : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup B] (e : A ≃+ B) (n : ℤ),
  (QuotientAddGroup.equivQuotientZSMulOfEquiv e n).symm = QuotientAddGroup.equivQuotientZSMulOfEquiv e.symm n

∀ {A B : Type u} [inst : CommGroup A] [inst_1 : CommGroup B] (e : A ≃* B) (n : ℤ),
  (QuotientGroup.equivQuotientZPowOfEquiv e n).symm = QuotientGroup.equivQuotientZPowOfEquiv e.symm n

∀ {A B C : Type u} [inst : CommGroup A] [inst_1 : CommGroup B] [inst_2 : CommGroup C] (e : A ≃* B) (d : B ≃* C) (n : ℤ),
  (QuotientGroup.equivQuotientZPowOfEquiv e n).trans (QuotientGroup.equivQuotientZPowOfEquiv d n) =
    QuotientGroup.equivQuotientZPowOfEquiv (e.trans d) n

∀ {A B C : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup B] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup C] (e : A ≃+ B) (d : B ≃+ C)
  (n : ℤ),
  (QuotientAddGroup.equivQuotientZSMulOfEquiv e n).trans (QuotientAddGroup.equivQuotientZSMulOfEquiv d n) =
    QuotientAddGroup.equivQuotientZSMulOfEquiv (e.trans d) n

statement:
{G : Type u} →

    (N : AddSubgroup G) →
      [nN : N.Normal] →
        (M : AddSubgroup G) → [nM : M.Normal] → N ≤ M → (G ⧸ N) ⧸ AddSubgroup.map (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) M →+ G ⧸ M

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] (N : AddSubgroup G) [nN : N.Normal] (M : AddSubgroup G) [nM : M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M)
  (x : G ⧸ N),
  (QuotientAddGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotientAux N M h) ↑x = (QuotientAddGroup.map N M (AddMonoidHom.id G) h) x

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [nN : N.Normal] (M : Subgroup G) [nM : M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M)
  (x : G ⧸ N), (QuotientGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotientAux N M h) ↑x = (QuotientGroup.map N M (MonoidHom.id G) h) x

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [nN : N.Normal] (M : Subgroup G) [nM : M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M) (x : G),
  (QuotientGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotientAux N M h) ↑↑x = ↑x

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] (N : AddSubgroup G) [nN : N.Normal] (M : AddSubgroup G) [nM : M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M)
  (x : G), (QuotientAddGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotientAux N M h) ↑↑x = ↑x

{G : Type u} →

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] (N : AddSubgroup G) [nN : N.Normal] (M : AddSubgroup G) [nM : M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M)
  (x : G), (QuotientAddGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient N M h).symm ↑x = ↑↑x

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [nN : N.Normal] (M : Subgroup G) [nM : M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M) (x : G),
  (QuotientGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient N M h).symm ↑x = ↑↑x

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] (N : AddSubgroup G) [nN : N.Normal] (M : AddSubgroup G) [nM : M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M)
  (x : G), (QuotientAddGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient N M h) ↑↑x = ↑x

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [nN : N.Normal] (M : Subgroup G) [nM : M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M) (x : G),
  (QuotientGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient N M h) ↑↑x = ↑x

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [inst_1 : N.Normal] (H : Subgroup (G ⧸ N)),
  N ≤ Subgroup.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) H

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] (N : AddSubgroup G) [inst_1 : N.Normal] (H : AddSubgroup (G ⧸ N)),
  N ≤ AddSubgroup.comap (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) H

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] (N H : AddSubgroup G) [inst_1 : N.Normal],
  AddSubgroup.comap (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) (AddSubgroup.map (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) H) = N ⊔ H

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (N H : Subgroup G) [inst_1 : N.Normal],
  Subgroup.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) H) = N ⊔ H

or fourth isomorphism theorem for multiplicative groups
statement: {G : Type u} → [inst : Group G] → (N : Subgroup G) → [hn : N.Normal] → Subgroup (G ⧸ N) ≃o ↑(Set.Ici N)

statement: {G : Type u} → [inst : AddGroup G] → (N : AddSubgroup G) → [hn : N.Normal] → AddSubgroup (G ⧸ N) ≃o ↑(Set.Ici N)
∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G], Subsingleton (G ⧸ ⊤)

doc: If the quotient by a subgroup gives a singleton then the subgroup is the whole group.
statement: ∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (H : Subgroup G), Subsingleton (G ⧸ H) → H = ⊤

doc:
If the quotient by an additive subgroup gives a singleton then the additive
subgroup is the whole additive group.
statement: ∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] (H : AddSubgroup G), Subsingleton (G ⧸ H) → H = ⊤

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] {H₁ : Subgroup G} [inst_1 : H₁.Normal] {H₂ : Subgroup (G ⧸ H₁)} [inst_2 : H₂.Normal],
  Subgroup.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' H₁) (Subgroup.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' H₂) (Subgroup.center ((G ⧸ H₁) ⧸ H₂))) =
    Subgroup.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' H₁) H₂))
      (Subgroup.center (G ⧸ Subgroup.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' H₁) H₂))

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] {H₁ : AddSubgroup G} [inst_1 : H₁.Normal] {H₂ : AddSubgroup (G ⧸ H₁)}
  [inst_2 : H₂.Normal],
  AddSubgroup.comap (QuotientAddGroup.mk' H₁)
      (AddSubgroup.comap (QuotientAddGroup.mk' H₂) (AddSubgroup.center ((G ⧸ H₁) ⧸ H₂))) =
    AddSubgroup.comap (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (AddSubgroup.comap (QuotientAddGroup.mk' H₁) H₂))
      (AddSubgroup.center (G ⧸ AddSubgroup.comap (QuotientAddGroup.mk' H₁) H₂))

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} [hH : H.Characteristic] {K : AddSubgroup (G ⧸ H)},
  K.Characteristic → (AddSubgroup.comap (QuotientAddGroup.mk' H) K).Characteristic

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] {H : Subgroup G} [hH : H.Characteristic] {K : Subgroup (G ⧸ H)},
  K.Characteristic → (Subgroup.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' H) K).Characteristic

doc:
The `MulEquiv` between the kernel of the restriction map to a normal subgroup `H` of homomorphisms
of type `G →* A` and the group of homomorphisms `G ⧸ H →* A`.
statement:
{G : Type u} →
  [inst : Group G] →
    (A : Type u_1) →
      [inst_1 : CommGroup A] →
        (H : Subgroup G) → [inst_2 : H.Normal] → ↥(MonoidHom.domRestrictHom H A).ker ≃* (G ⧸ H →* A)

doc:
The `AddEquiv` between the kernel of the restriction map to a normal subgroup `H` of homomorphisms
of type `G →+ A` and the group of homomorphisms `G ⧸ H →+ A`.
statement:
{G : Type u} →
  [inst : AddGroup G] →
    (A : Type u_1) →
      [inst_1 : AddCommGroup A] →
        (H : AddSubgroup G) → [inst_2 : H.Normal] → ↥(AddMonoidHom.domRestrictHom H A).ker ≃+ (G ⧸ H →+ A)

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (A : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommGroup A] (H : Subgroup G) [inst_2 : H.Normal]
  (f : ↥(MonoidHom.domRestrictHom H A).ker) (g : G), ((MonoidHom.domRestrictHomKerEquiv A H) f) ↑g = ↑f g

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] (A : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommGroup A] (H : Subgroup G) [inst_2 : H.Normal]
  (f : G ⧸ H →* A) (g : G), ↑((MonoidHom.domRestrictHomKerEquiv A H).symm f) g = f ↑g
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : NonAssocRing R] (N : AddSubgroup R) [inst_1 : N.Normal] (n : ℕ) (a : R), ↑(↑n * a) = n • ↑a
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : NonAssocRing R] (N : AddSubgroup R) [inst_1 : N.Normal] (n : ℤ) (a : R), ↑(↑n * a) = n • ↑a

doc:
The isomorphism between the quotient of a product by the image of the `n`th power map
and the product of the quotients by the images of the `n`th power maps on the factors.
statement:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  (A : ι → Type u_2) →
    [inst : (i : ι) → CommGroup (A i)] →
      (n : ℕ) → ((i : ι) → A i) ⧸ (powMonoidHom n).range ≃* ((i : ι) → A i ⧸ (powMonoidHom n).range)

doc:
The isomorphism between the quotient of a product by the image of the multiplication-by-`n`
map and the product of the quotients by the images of the multiplication-by-`n` maps
on the factors.
statement:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  (A : ι → Type u_2) →
    [inst : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup (A i)] →
      (n : ℕ) → ((i : ι) → A i) ⧸ (nsmulAddMonoidHom n).range ≃+ ((i : ι) → A i ⧸ (nsmulAddMonoidHom n).range)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (A : ι → Type u_2) [inst : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup (A i)] (n : ℕ) (x : (i : ι) → A i),
  (QuotientAddGroup.addEquivPiModRangeNSMulAddMonoidHom A n) ↑x = fun i => ↑(x i)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (A : ι → Type u_2) [inst : (i : ι) → CommGroup (A i)] (n : ℕ) (x : (i : ι) → A i),
  (QuotientGroup.mulEquivPiModRangePowMonoidHom A n) ↑x = fun i => ↑(x i)
